question: When the primary tributaries of rivers flow parallel to each other and secondary tributaries join them at right angles, the pattern is known as _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**trellis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• This pattern is typically found in regions with folded or tilted sedimentary rocks, where alternating bands of hard and soft rocks exist.
 
• The main river channel often follows the valley formed by the erosion of softer rocks, while the tributaries flow along the valleys between the harder, more resistant rock layers.
 
• The trellis pattern resembles a vine or trellis with its main stem and lateral branches, hence its name.
 
• Examples of rivers exhibiting this pattern include those in the Appalachian Mountains of North America and the Himalayas in Asia.
